verdict.rationale: Concurrency limits are a fair question for a local LLM server, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an OpenAI-like local and network server, headless mode, and on-demand loading, but nothing states a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or when throughput degrades. Missing for 10: any documented concurrency or connection limit, and any throughput-degradation guidance or benchmarks.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
